methodology: Preserve every currently named position unless stronger evidence requires a reorder.
Weight official and regular-time penalty events above press, specialist guides and career databases.
Use FutbolFantasy only as corroboration or historical baseline.
Force three practical names per club and put uncertainty in status, confidence and notes instead of blanks.
Treat shootouts as depth evidence, not proof of regular-time order.
Expose uncompleted moves as transfer conditions, not completed squad changes.

confidence_definitions.medium: Corroborated deputy role or strong current career evidence.
confidence_definitions.low: Practical squad inference without a current regular-time assignment.
